name: I Am That I Am
overview: The name "I Am That I Am" reveals God's self-existence and eternal nature, as He declares to Moses that He is the unchanging and sovereign One who sent him (Exodus 3:14). This divine name is echoed in the book of Revelation, where Jesus Christ identifies Himself as the Alpha and Omega, the first and the last, emphasizing His eternal presence and authority over all things (Revelation 1:4, 1:11, 1:17). Together, these verses affirm the deity of God and Christ, highlighting God's eternal, self-sufficient, and unchanging nature as the foundation of Christian faith.
